samples.question: The gold tag starts the reference section. Follow its four straight steps through the three pale bend pegs. For each red, green, and blue tag, follow the next four steps likewise. A candidate matches only if one rigid rotation of the whole section, without reflection or reordering, makes all four steps and bends coincide with the reference. Which candidate tag color marks the match? Answer red, green, or blue.
